Cookie Policy

How we collect, use and protect your personal information.

Last updated: September 30th, 2025

In this Cookie Policy, we explain how we collect, use and protect your personal information. We also describe how you can manage and take control. This Cookies Policy supplements the StillCraft Events Co. Privacy Policy and explains how and why we use these technologies and the choices you have.

Feel free to contact us anytime at info@stillcraftevents.co.ke.

WHAT IS A COOKIE?

Like any other website, StillCraft Events Co. website («Website») uses ‘cookies’. These cookies are used to store information including visitors’ preferences, and the pages on the Website that the visitor accessed or visited.

A cookie is a file that is downloaded to the connected device when accessing certain web pages, containing information that allow us to understand how our users navigate through our website, and thus work on the constant improvement of the navigation process. Also, it allows us to store and retrieve information about the navigation that is carried out from said service.

Cookies have an expiration date, which can range from the duration of the session to a specified future date after which they cease to be operational.

StillCraft Events Co. (hereinafter «StillCraft Events Co.»), directly and via a third party contracted for providing measurement services, use cookies and other similar mechanisms for storing and retrieving data from terminals (hereinafter «cookies») when you browse the Website to allow and facilitate your interaction with the Website and provide you with essential features and services and additional purposes.

If you are uncomfortable with the use of cookies, at any time, you can manage and control them through your browser, including removing cookies, through the cookie settings panel provided on our Website or by deleting them from your ‘browser history’ (cache) when you leave the site. Please note that if you choose to delete or reject cookies or clear local storage, it may affect the features, availability, and functionality of the Website. The ‘Help’ feature on most browsers will tell you how to prevent your browser from accepting new cookies, how to have the browser notify you when you receive a new cookie, how to block cookies, and when cookies will expire.

WHY DOES STILLCRAFT USE THESE COOKIES?

The use of Cookies allows us to:

  • Better understand how you browse and interact with the StillCraft Events Website and improving it.
  • Monitoring and analyzing the performance, operation, and effectiveness of our website.
  • For internal customer support, analysis, research, product development, and regulatory compliance purposes.
  • Adapt and personalize the contents and services offered on the websites where we serve advertising.
  • Segment and control the frequency with which the ads are displayed on the websites where we serve advertising.

TYPES OF COOKIES

a) According to the entity that manages them, there are own cookies (those that are sent to the user’s terminal equipment from a computer or domain managed by the editor itself, from which the requested service is provided by the user) and third-party cookies (those that are sent to the user’s terminal equipment from a computer or domain that is not managed by the editor but by another entity that processes the data obtained through cookies).

b) According to the time they remain active, there are session cookies (designed to request and store data while the user accesses a web page) and persistent cookies (where data is stored on the terminal and can be accessed and processed for a period defined by the cookie’s controller – which can range from a few minutes to several years).

c) According to the purpose for which they process the information they collect, they can be:

  • Technical cookies (necessary for the use of the website and the provision of the contracted service),
  • Personalization cookies (which allow the user to access the service with predefined characteristics, such as language, browser type, regional settings, etc.),
  • Analytics cookies (collect information about the use made of the website),
  • Advertising cookies (collect information about user preferences and personal choices),
  • Affiliate cookies (allow tracking visits from other websites with which the website establishes an affiliate agreement).

You can adjust your browser settings to manage cookie preferences and prevent the use of these and other data collection technologies. All browsers are different, so you should visit your browser’s help section for more information on cookie preferences and other available settings. Please note that if you choose to delete or reject cookies or clear local storage, it may affect the features, availability, and functionality of the Proper Homes Platform.

WHAT TYPE OF COOKIES DO WE USE?

  • Strictly Necessary or Technical Cookies:

These cookies are necessary for the correct use of the website. They allow the user to browse through our Website and to use the different options or services available, such as controlling traffic and data communication, identifying the session, accessing restricted areas, or using security elements while browsing. Without these cookies, some or all of the services available would not be operational.

  • Analytics/Measurement Cookies:

We use Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager (third-party cookies, only in production) to help us measure and analyze how visitors use our Website. These cookies make it possible to: distinguish between users and sessions, remember session status and traffic sources, limit the frequency of requests to improve site performance, and support advertising attribution and campaign measurement.

These cookies are generally stored for limited periods (from a few minutes up to two years, depending on the cookie) and provide aggregated information that helps us improve the user experience and optimize our content.

  • Functional or Personalization Cookies:

These cookies remember information such as your username, language, or the region you are in, and allow us to provide enhanced, personalized features. For example, they can enable customizable content or provide certain requested services, such as watching a video or posting a comment.

  • Advertising Cookies:

These cookies allow for the efficient management of advertising spaces. They make it possible to adapt ads to the user’s device and interests, and to deliver advertising managed by third parties.

YOUR CHOICES: MANAGE, BLOCK OR DISABLE COOKIES

  • You can accept or decline cookies via our “Cookie Consent Banner” located at the bottom of our Website. And alternatively, you can allow, block or delete cookies installed on your computer by configuring the options of the browser installed on your computer. Most browsers allow you to set an alert each time a cookie is placed on your computer, block and/or disable existing cookies. Generally, you can do this via the browser settings and preferences.
  • Settings depending on browser will be located:
    • Microsoft Edge: microsoft.com/es-es/help/4468242/microsoft-edge-browsing-data-and-privacy-microsoft-privacy
    • FireFox: mozilla.org/es/kb/Borrar%20cookies
    • Chrome: google.com/chrome/answer/95647?hl=”es”
    • Safari: apple.com/es/privacy/use-of-cookies/
  • Please note that if you choose to delete or reject cookies or clear local storage, it may affect the features, availability, and functionality of the StillCraft Events Website.

UPDATES TO THE COOKIES POLICY

  • StillCraft Events Co. International Events S.L.U. may update this Cookies Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, legal requirements, or our business practices. We encourage you to review this Policy periodically for any updates or changes.
  • If you have any questions or concerns about this Cookies Policy, please contact us at info@stillcraftevents.co.ke
